STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT AND MATERIALITY ASSESSMENT                                                                                                             Approach to Double Materiality
                                                                                                                                                              The Company applies a double materiality framework to evaluate sustainability matters from two complementary
Prioritising Material Issues                                                                                                                                  perspectives. Impact materiality assesses the positive and negative effects of CEAT’s operations, products, and value
                                                                                                                                                              chain on the environment and society, based on severity, scale, and remediability; while financial materiality
                                                                                                                                                              evaluates risks and opportunities that may influence financial performance, access to capital, and long-term value
through Inclusive Engagement                                                                                                                                  creation across relevant capitals and time horizons.
                                                                                                                                                              A topic is considered material if it meets either criterion, with rankings validated through management deliberations,
                                                                                                                                                              investor inputs, and industry benchmarks. Detailed disclosures on the methodology and identified material topics are
Stakeholder engagement remains integral to the Company’s strategic decision-making, enabling sustained value                                                  available in the Company’s double materiality report:
creation through regular dialogue with identified key stakeholder groups based on influence, impact, and                                                      https://www.ceat.com/content/dam/ceat/pdf/sustainability-page/ceat-double-materiality-report.pdf
dependency. The Company continues to engage with stakeholder categories, with periodic reviews, ensuring
alignment of strategy with evolving stakeholder expectations.                                                                                                 Materiality Matrix
In FY 2024–25, the Company undertook a comprehensive double materiality assessment aligned with recognised
frameworks, including GRI, SASB, EU CSRD/EFRAG and MSCI, evaluating both impact materiality (environmental and                                                    High
social impact) and financial materiality. This framework was further strengthened in FY 2025–26 through the
Stakeholder Engagement and Materiality Assessment (SEMA), incorporating stakeholder consultations, internal
evaluations and sectoral analysis to refine strategy, strengthen risk management, and guide capital allocation. The
assessment process, conducted triennially with interim reviews for evolving business and regulatory dynamics,                                                                                                                                         Product Innovation,
continues to identify fifteen material topics which remain unchanged and form the basis for disclosures,                                                                                                                                               Quality and Safety
accountability, and focused resource allocation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       Sustainable

Global Recognition for Quality Excellence
The  Deming Grand Prize is one of the highest forms of global recognition for organisations that demonstrate
excellence in quality and management practices, awarded to companies that consistently improve processes,
minimise defects, and deliver superior products and services over time. The Company’s achievement of this
recognition reflects its sustained commitment to Total Quality Management, built over an 18 years journey of
embedding quality-driven practices across the organisation, including the attainment of the Deming Prize in 2017 and
the Deming Grand Prize in 2023.

                                                                                                                                                       Tyre Industry Overview
Management Discussion                                                                                                                                  The tyre industry recorded strong growth during FY 2025–26, with overall volumes expanding in double digits,
                                                                                                                                                       supported by robust performance across both replacement and OEM segments. Demand momentum strengthened
and Analysis                                                                                                                                           in the second half following GST rationalisation, leading to stimulated consumption across key categories. The
                                                                                                                                                       replacement segment remained the primary growth driver, led by higher vehicle utilisation, and sustained traction in
                                                                                                                                                       the two-wheeler segment. OEM demand also remained healthy, with strong growth in utility vehicle segments. Export
Global Economic Outlook                                                 These movements impacted import costs, export                                  markets witnessed a mixed trend, with strong growth in regions such as Europe and the United States, partly offset by
                                                                        competitiveness and overall demand conditions in                               disruptions in the Middle East due to geopolitical tensions. Overall, the industry demonstrated resilience during the

                                                                                                                                                       Raw Material Trends
                                                                                                                                                       Raw material prices, particularly natural rubber, remained volatile due to supply constraints and logistical disruptions.
                                                                                                                                                       The industry is progressively adopting sustainable alternatives such as recovered carbon black and rice husk silica.
                                                                                                                                                       Increased use of recycled and sustainable materials is expected to enhance resilience against price and supply
                                                                                                                                                       volatility.
                                                                                                                                                       Business Review
                                                                                                                                                       The Company operated in a dynamic environment during FY 2025–26, characterised by input cost volatility and
                                                                                                                                                       geopolitical uncertainties. The demand environment on the other hand remained healthy. Led by strong execution, the
                                                                                                                                                       Company witnessed a landmark year and crossed the Rs. 15,000 Crore revenue milestone with revenue growing 19%.
                                                                                                                                                       The growth was strong across all segments. Replacement grew by 10.80%, OEM by 23% and Export 18.49%. The raw
                                                                                                                                                       material prices moderated in the second half of the year. Driven further by operating efficiencies, the Company’s
                                                                                                                                                       consolidated net profit increased by 48% over FY2024-25. Strategic focus remained on strengthening market position,
                                                                                                                                                       improving product mix and enhancing operational efficiency.
                                                                                                                                                       The Company’s strategy is anchored on the following:
                                                                                                                                                       a) Replacement Market
                                                                                                                                                       The replacement segment remained the largest contributor to revenue and profitability. The Company strengthened
  Steering through challenges with agility and a focus on long-term growth.                                                                            its position through distribution expansion, enhanced dealer engagement and increased adoption of digital
                                                                                                                                                       platforms, improving network efficiency and customer reach.

Occupational Health and Safety
The Company maintains a strong safety culture supported by ISO 45001-certified systems, structured training
programmes and regular audits. The focus remains on achieving a zero-incident workplace. Employee well-being is
supported through comprehensive health programmes, workplace monitoring and medical facilities across all
manufacturing locations as elaborated in this Integrated Annual Report.
Environment and Sustainability
The Company is committed to achieving net-zero emissions by 2050 through energy efficiency, clean energy
adoption and sustainable manufacturing practices. Climate-related risks are managed through a structured ESG
governance framework.
